The official site has a credit card promotions listing. No card product catalogue URL was found on the homepage or the spend-save page. The credit card nav item points at the promotions listing.

Ordinary browser mode reached the official site. The credit card catalogue lists consumer cards including CardX Beyond, JCB Platinum, King Power Platinum, UP2ME, Family Plus and Ultra Platinum. The site states CardX is in the SCBX group; SCB itself has no website on the BOT list, so this is recorded as its own issuer, not same_group. A linked host info.cardx.co.th was not added to official_domains.

2026-11-24 run 20261124-0950-th-bangkok-bank: first card and offer run, English only, real Chrome (www.bangkokbank.com is in config/real_chrome_hosts.json). Recipes: config/recipes/th-bangkok-bank-cards.json and config/recipes/th-bangkok-bank-offers.json. The English catalogue https://www.bangkokbank.com/en/personal/cards/credit-cards lists 19 consumer credit cards, all handed in. The suggestor JSON also has JCB Ultimate, JCB Platinum and a Test New CC row without English product pages; those were not invented as cards. The complete official promotions listing is https://www.bangkokbank.com/apiaem/content/bangkokbank/en/personal/cards/credit-cards/promotions.allpromo.json (238 promotions: 157 still active and 81 expired as of 2026-11-24). The tabbed HTML promotions page is incomplete (paginated tiles). A time cap mid-run read 43 of the 157 active detail pages (listing_complete is false). Expired promotions were not handed in. 113 active promotions were not read. English product pages often state a spend-based waiver of entrance and annual fees but not the fee amount; Pinnacle and Visa Infinite do not state a card fee in the English text. GraphQL income figures were not used because they are not quoted on the product pages. robots.txt was read with real Chrome (200).

The official cards page lists consumer credit cards (for example AEON Gold, Visa Platinum, World Mastercard, J Premier Platinum). The fetcher classed the pages login_required because a password field is present; the public catalogue was still readable.
